title: Parse duration strings
requirement: Implement `parse_duration(text: str) -> int` that converts a duration such as '1h30m', '45s', '2d4h' or '1h 15m 30s' to a total number of seconds. Units are d (86400 s), h (3600 s), m (60 s) and s (1 s); each unit may appear at most once, in any order; whitespace between parts is allowed. Raise ValueError for an empty string, a number without a unit, a unit without a number, an unknown unit, or a repeated unit.
